version.approval_notes: Version 2.0.2 adds an opt-in, disabled-by-default Share Links shortcut for authorized Odoo Customer Success users. It appears only on server-confirmed draft or sent Renewal Quotations and Sales quotations, including Success Packs, after validating the exact active sale.order route, record ID, target type, and technical renewal state where required. An explicit user click invokes Odoo's native portal.share default_get contract through the current same-origin session, validates the returned tokenized URL against the exact current sale.order, and writes it to the clipboard. The extension requests clipboardWrite only for this user-triggered write; it never reads the clipboard, sends a Share email, stores or logs the URL or access token, or transmits them to the developer. The update adds no analytics, advertising, external service, background worker, or data collection. Firefox is signed from the exact attached, checksummed build artifact; the attached human-readable source archive contains tracked regular files only and can be reproduced with Node 22 and pnpm 10.
